REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: The delivered packet gives the participant two contradictory answers about what Exhibit B is and whether the docket sheet is required. Page 1 (cover and contents, composed from the specification's participantChecklist) prints: "Insert the participant-supplied certified disposition as Exhibit A and docket sheet as Exhibit B; the generated assembly checklist is not an attachment." Page 9 (EXHIBIT CHECKLIST, composed from the memo track) prints: "EXHIBIT B - ONLY WHERE THE CASE WAS INDICTED. A copy of the indictment…" and lists the docket sheet under "ADVISABLE". Identical on both fixtures. Each page reproduces its own bound source faithfully — the specification (filing steps and checklist, current and pinned alike, and the petition text that attaches "the docket sheet … as Exhibit B") and the memo (indictment conditional, docket sheet advisable) disagree — so the two composition sources conflict and the packet prints both. A participant cannot tell whether to obtain the docket sheet before filing or what to label it, and the petition in the packet attaches no Exhibit B at all. This is internal inconsistency on participant-facing pages (DET-FEE-AND-WAIVER-001-A4: a packet may not tell a participant two different things about the same requirement) and it exists at the pinned specification too, so it is independent of the drift. Not recorded by VF04, VF12, VF13, VF15 or VF16 (neither rows file mentions Exhibit B). requiredFactsNotCollected=0 and unclassifiedBlanks=0 measured here; the counters do not see this.
